div.div: صِنَابِىٌّ , applied to a horse (M, A, TA) or similar beast, (M, TA,) or to a hackney, (TA,) and to a camel, (M, TA,) Of a colour between redness and yellowness, (M, A, K, TA,) with abundance of hair, and of fur: (TA:) or of a bay, or dark bay, or brown, colour; syn. كُمَيْتٌ: (S, O, K:) or of a sorrel colour; syn. أَشْقَرُ: (K:) or of this last colour having some white hairs intermixed therewith: (S, O, TA:) so called because his colour resembles the sauce termed صِنَاب: (TA:) صِنَابِىٌّ being a rel. noun from صِنَابٌ. (S, O, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
